selection_policy: Official specifications and project documentation for policy, delegation, workload identity, agent security limitations and provenance.

sources.title: Cedar Policy Language Documentation
limitations: Does not issue credentials or enforce physical effects
Aurora fit requires a policy spike

sources.title: Open Policy Agent Documentation
supports: separation of policy decision and enforcement
limitations: Does not define Aurora domain or physical enforcement
Policy maintainability and deployment require testing

sources.title: OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange (RFC 8693)
limitations: Web/API authorization standard, not complete Aurora authority or device model

sources.title: SPIFFE Documentation — SVIDs
supports: service identity independent of network location
limitations: Operational overhead may be excessive for early single-user deployment

sources.title: Pi Coding Agent
supports: agent process uses host permissions unless externally isolated
limitations: Repository/version details must be reverified at implementation
Pi is not selected as Aurora Core

sources.title: OpenHands Security Architecture
limitations: Does not replace Aurora threat model

sources.title: SLSA Provenance v1.2
limitations: Provenance does not prove functional correctness or safe source code
